name: Sakuma Toshizou
source:
The president of a major entertainment agency.
One of the directors of Minomori Private Academy.
Possessing a mysterious charisma, he has often acted as a leader in groups since he was young.
During this time, he gathered together a group of entertainer and model scouts and founded an entertainment talent agency.
A man who will stop at nothing to succeed, he has used various methods to rise to the top and become a respected figure in the entertainment industry.
There are endless dark rumors surrounding both him and his agency, but they are all just rumors.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonotsubasa/]official site[/url]]
